## Problem and change / সমস্যা ও পরিবর্তন

What problem does this solve, and what will users see after this change?

Related issue, if any:

## Validation / পরীক্ষা

List checks actually run and their results. Include OS/Python versions. State which platforms you did not test. Use mocked scanner responses or local test fixtures; do not attach real target reports. Production has no offline demo mode.

## Contributor checklist / অবদানকারীর তালিকা

- [ ] This PR is focused, and I reviewed the diff.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests, or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation; translation help is welcome.
- [ ] I considered Kali/Linux, Windows and macOS behavior and stated any limitation.
- [ ] I included no secrets, personal data, real scan evidence, environments or scanner binaries.
- [ ] I preserved attribution and identified any added third-party source/license.
- [ ] The change preserves explicit scope, visible failures and local-only defaults.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/mdnhbn/echo-recon-workspace/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), [CONTRIBUTING.bn.md](https://github.com/mdnhbn/echo-recon-workspace/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.bn.md) and [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/mdnhbn/echo-recon-workspace/blob/main/NOTICE.md). A PR does not change the project's licensing status.
